thread:
Alex C.: Hey team — spotting a mismatch during month close. Dashboard CSV for acct AC1234 totals $12,102.90 but invoice INV-2026-03-AC1234 shows $12,345.67. ~ $242.77 diff. Looks like two dashboard rows (ingest, background-embed) were merged into a single invoice line. Can someone triage? :thinking_face:
BillingBot: Invoice INV-2026-03-AC1234 generation completed (job gen-invoices-20260301) at 2026-03-01T02:00:12Z.
Maria S.: Thanks Alex. Can you paste the dashboard export snippet + invoice lines? Also need the internal timestamp window used for the export.
Alex C.: Pasting minimal excerpts below (dashboard export came from /billing/exports/AC1234-2026-03-01.csv):
```
# dashboard_export.csv (columns: customer, plan, bucket, tokens, dollars)
AC1234,standard,ingest,1,234,900, 8,102.90
AC1234,standard,background-embed,45,000, 4,000.00
```
and invoice CSV (from accounting):
```
# invoice_INV-2026-03-AC1234.csv (columns: customer, plan, description, tokens, dollars)
AC1234,standard,ingest + background-embed,1,279,900, 12,345.67
```
Alex C.: Export and invoice generated using the same nominal billing window (2026-02-01T00:00Z -> 2026-02-28T23:59:59Z).
Sam R.: I can run the support query to compare aggregation keys. Run this on prod-reports (read-only):
```sql
SELECT customer_id, plan, bucket, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM billing_events
WHERE customer_id = 'AC1234'
  AND event_ts >= '2026-02-01' AND event_ts < '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY 1,2,3;
```
Sam R.: Also check for jobs that have both a task_id and a job_id — historically we grouped invoice lines by job_id, dashboard by task_id.
Kevin L.: Ran the query — found duplicate rows where the same token counts are recorded under two task_ids but share one job_id (background-embed worker retried with new task_id). Dashboard groups by task_id so shows two lines; invoice generator groups by job_id and collapsed them. Root cause = inconsistent grouping keys between systems.
Kevin L.: Quick repro excerpt:
```
# billing_events samples
job_id: jb-9001, task_id: t-1001, bucket: background-embed, tokens: 30,000
job_id: jb-9001, task_id: t-1002, bucket: background-embed, tokens: 15,000  -- retry
```
Kevin L.: Invoice job does: GROUP BY customer_id, job_id, bucket. Dashboard export does: GROUP BY customer_id, task_id, bucket. That explains the merge.
Maria S.: Ugh. Did invoice generator dedupe intentionally? Any older invoices impacted?
Kevin L.: It was intentional to dedupe duplicate job submissions, but we missed the retry->new-task pattern. Scope: likely affects any account with retrying background jobs in the window. I scanned most recent month and found ~12 customers with small deltas.
Jess P.: Recommendation: issue a one-time adjustment credit for AC1234 for $242.77, escalate a fix to invoice generator to align grouping with dashboard (or vice-versa) and add a reconciliation flag for future runs. I'll approve the credit if finance OKs. :white_check_mark:
Maria S.: Finance, can you confirm we can apply a negative invoice item / credit? Tagging @Kevin L. to include suggested fix and rollout plan.
Sam R.: Proposed short-term patch: change invoice generator grouping to (customer_id, COALESCE(task_id, job_id), bucket) and log collision events to a dedicated table. Longer-term: normalize billing_events to include canonical_aggregation_id.
BillingBot: Created ticket BILL-4521: "Invoice grouping mismatch: job_id vs task_id" with link https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-4521
Kevin L.: I'll open a PR for the quick patch and add an integration test to ensure invoice vs dashboard exports are parity for retry cases. PR: https://github.com/redwood/billing/pull/289 (draft)
Jess P.: Finance confirmed — apply credit and tag as "post-close adjustment". Jess P. issued credit note CN-2026-03-77 for $242.77 against INV-2026-03-AC1234.
Alex C.: Thanks all. Can someone post the follow-up once PR merged? I'll update the customer success thread so CS can notify the customer with the credit note. :pray:
Kevin L.: Will do. Targeting hotfix deploy to staging tomorrow, prod after smoke tests.
Alex C.: Closing loop — credit applied, customer notified, PR linked. Keeping this thread for postmortem notes. Thanks! :thumbsup:
